text: Q. This meme originates from a 2020 documentary series about one of the greatest sporting dynasties in American history, in which its subject — already legendary for an almost pathological competitiveness — recounts repeatedly how minor slights, casual doubts, and throwaway remarks from opponents and teammates alike were quietly catalogued and converted into fuel. Funny thing is, the phrase used as caption in the image was never in the documentary but misattributed to the scene. What is this versatile template used innumerably till date by memers?
